findings.reason: Unconditional synthetic implicit usings can change real overload selection. A verified contextual caller was attributed to the wrong overload and the real overload was withheld.
findings.repair: Bind under authorized or explicit project context. Withhold verified call relationships whose target depends on an unsupported assumption about implicit imports. Exercise both direct and contextual queries.

findings.reason: A top-level colon inside an annotation truncates the inferred function header. A leading continuation was included in a claimed annotation span. Invalid parameter ordering and a reserved keyword parameter passed arity checks and seeded verified follow-ups.
findings.repair: Prove declaration grammar and exact span boundaries for the supported subset. Withhold unsupported annotations, malformed declarations, and follow-ups through them. Preserve positive results on supported syntax.
